## Summary

Household gas usage varies widely across Indonesian provinces. This study applies hierarchical clustering to group provinces based on their household gas usage ratios in 2023, revealing regional consumption patterns useful for energy policy.

## Contribution

- Hierarchical clustering analysis of household energy data at provincial scale.
- Insights into regional disparities in domestic gas consumption.
